title: Reading Comprehension UI Rendering Instructions
description: Guidance for Copilot to render AFOQT-style reading passages and grouped questions.

uiTypes.description: A scrollable or fixed-height text container showing the passage in plain text.
renderingStrategy: 1. Render the passage inside a div with class 'rcPassage'.
2. Use a clean serif or sans-serif font for readability.
3. Maintain consistent line spacing and margins.
4. Keep the background plain white or theme-default.
5. No graphics, charts, or UI embellishment; adhere to exam-like simplicity.

uiTypes.description: Question text and multiple-choice format under the passage.
renderingStrategy: 1. Render questions sequentially under the passage.
2. Use radio buttons or clickable divs for choices.
3. Preserve consistent spacing to visually link questions to the passage.
4. In non-test mode, show explanation after user selection.

implementationNotesForCopilot: Reading Comprehension UI must remain minimal — no specialized graphics.
Maintain a consistent exam-feel: black text on white background.
Keep passage and questions vertically aligned for user comfort.
In practiceTestMode, do not show explanations until after completion.
